# [RUN APPENDIX] Coverage, source test and checks, 2026-11-03

## Run note
The scheduled firing on 1 Nov 2026 fell on an even ISO week and stopped by design. This run was started manually on 3 Nov 2026 and is a full scan.

## Source test (real calls this run)

| Source | Result | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| PubMed (MCP) | reached | Multiple searches across all lanes plus article metadata; abstracts read; PMC full text for the three dossier papers |
| ClinicalTrials.gov (MCP) | reached | Searches for melasma, alopecia, CCCA; records read for NCT07876323, NCT07734870, NCT07843732 |
| Crossref API | reached | First attempt rate limited, retry worked |
| Europe PMC REST | reached | First attempt rate limited, worked on retry |
| J-STAGE, EU Clinical Trials Register, PMDA, EU health committees | reached | Pages loaded; nothing listed from them |
| Health Canada recalls | reached | Recall pages read (Renpure scalp products, 5 Jun 2026; Maison Luce serum, 18 Feb 2026). Landing page to 30 Oct showed no cosmetic recalls |
| FDA recalls | reached | Landing page to 30 Oct showed no cosmetic recalls |
| TGA | reached | Counterfeit Botox import notice (undated page) |
| EU SCCS | reached | Final opinions on acetophenone and heliotropin (15 Oct 2026); pending mandates noted |
| Sephora, Boots, Hwahae, @cosme | partial | Landing pages only; no product comparisons made |
| ISRCTN, ANZCTR, UMIN, ChiCTR, CiNii, medRxiv, bioRxiv, SSRN, Google Patents, EU CTIS | landing only | Landing pages loaded; registry searches were not run |
| KoreaMed | unreliable | Returned "0 results / unusually high traffic"; not retried |
| health-products.canada.ca | failed | Client error |
| Cosmetics Design | thin | Undated or thin results |
| CRIS, KCI, RISS, KIPRIS | not retried | Not attempted this run |

## Lane coverage checklist
- HPA axis / nervous system: PubMed searched twice. One entry (sensitive-skin lifestyle phenotypes).
- Black and melanin-rich skin: searched. Entries: melasma combination, insulin resistance and PIH, visible light, eflornithine triple cream.
- Tools and devices: searched. Six PMIDs from the device search did not return metadata, so those hits were not triaged. Entry: 532 nm picosecond freckles.
- Clinic and medspa incl. Korean: PubMed plus one WebSearch (titles only). Entries: PDRN iontophoresis model, glutathione/HA/laser/TXA.
- Hair and scalp: PubMed plus ClinicalTrials.gov. Entries: tirzepatide CCCA pilot, bond-builder commentary.
- Goals-aligned science: searched. Entry: periocular dermocosmetics review.
- Entropy wildcard: tirzepatide pilot in scarring alopecia, with the GLP-1 alopecia meta-analysis for context.
- Rx / OTC: searched. Entry: eflornithine triple cream trial.

## Watch re-check (prior Watch items)
- Mevalonolactone: no change found.
- Thiamidol: no change found.
- Scalp seborrheic dermatitis / androgenetic alopecia framework: no change found.
- TriHex periprocedural serum: no change found.
- Topical PDRN versus retinol: no change found. The iontophoresis paper this run is context, not a replication.
- LED systematic review: no change found.
- Toner with hydroquinone safety study: no change found.
- Device review: no change found.
- Baricitinib CCCA trial (NCT07843732): still completed, no results posted.

## Limits worth knowing
- Primary iron-oxide sunscreen trials were not found by PubMed search; the visible-light entry's figures are secondhand from a review abstract.
- Most triage entries are abstract-level reads.

## Build facts
Tailwind compiled via npx (tailwindcss 3.4.17); no cached-CSS fallback message was printed. RDKit was not installed and was not needed: no ingredient structures this run. Build output: 23 entries total (10 new).

# [RUN APPENDIX] Coverage, source test and checks, 2026-10-25

## Source test (real calls this run; nothing is claimed as covered without one)
Unattended note: WebFetch refused every URL that was only listed in the task prompt (error PROVENANCE_REQUIRED, "permission request not answered"), but fetched pages whose URLs had come back from a WebSearch result. So registries and regulators were reached through site-scoped WebSearch (titles and URLs only) and then fetched where a result URL was returned.

| Source | Result | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| PubMed (MCP) | reached | 16 searches and article metadata; abstracts read; PMC full text for 2 papers |
| ClinicalTrials.gov (MCP) | reached | 2 searches (skin, alopecia); 1 full record read (NCT07843732) |
| Europe PMC REST (listed URL) | blocked | WebFetch PROVENANCE_REQUIRED, retried once, same error. Not an HTTP 429 this time. Europe PMC also surfaced through search results only |
| Crossref API (listed URL) | blocked | WebFetch PROVENANCE_REQUIRED; one attempt |
| J-STAGE search, KoreaMed search, EU Clinical Trials Register (listed URLs) | blocked | PROVENANCE_REQUIRED. Site-scoped WebSearch returned KoreaMed Synapse and J-STAGE article pages (titles only, not read) |
| EU CTIS, ISRCTN, ANZCTR, UMIN, ChiCTR, CiNii, PMDA, Google Patents (listed URLs) | blocked | PROVENANCE_REQUIRED. Site-scoped WebSearch returned ISRCTN PDFs and a ChiCTR record (titles only, not read); nothing returned for the others |
| medRxiv, bioRxiv, SSRN | blocked / partial | Listed URLs PROVENANCE_REQUIRED. WebSearch returned bioRxiv preprint titles (not read); medRxiv and SSRN nothing |
| Health Canada recalls | reached | Listed landing URL blocked; two recall pages reached via search results (RELLET spray, 5 Aug 2026; Truly Tallow, 21 Jan 2026) |
| FDA recalls | partial | Listed URL blocked; search returned guidance pages and one 2026 warning-letter title (not read); no skincare recall confirmed |
| TGA | partial | Search returned pages; the 4-MBC safety review PDF was robots-blocked on fetch |
| EU SCCS | reached | Opinions page fetched via search result; newest opinion listed was 30 April 2026 (the page may be behind: an earlier run saw a 30 July 2026 request) |
| Cosmetics Design Asia / Europe, Premium Beauty News | partial | Premium Beauty News headlines via search; one article read (supplier claim). Cosmetics Design not reached |
| Olive Young Global | partial | Search returned product pages (not opened); Hwahae and @cosme returned nothing |
| Sephora (Canada) | reached | Olaplex curl shampoo page read |
| Boots | not reached | No search result and listed URL blocked |
| Retailer pages for named products | reached | Canyon Ranch (US) and BeautySense.ca (CA) for the peptide serum, Sephora Canada for the curl shampoo |

## Lane coverage checklist
- HPA axis / nervous system: PubMed searched 3 ways (stress and skin interventions; ashwagandha, vagus nerve or HRV with skin; psychodermatology RCTs). Results were mostly off-topic; one lead worth listing (hair cortisol, entry 7). Otherwise searched, nothing worth listing.
- Black and melanin-rich skin: PubMed (skin of colour trials), ClinicalTrials.gov, hair and scalp searches. Entries: CCCA registry, toner-with-hydroquinone safety study, device review.
- Tools and devices: PubMed (energy devices, LED and microcurrent). Entries: device review, LED systematic review. Microcurrent: searched, nothing worth listing.
- Clinic and medspa incl. Korean clinics: PubMed (PDRN, exosome, microneedling, RF, laser in Asian skin), one WebSearch on new Korean clinic skin-booster launches (titles only, nothing opened). Entries: peptide aftercare serum, PDRN. Platelet-rich plasma for melasma (photothermal vs conventional PRP, 26 women, both arms PRP, no difference in mMASI) was read at abstract level and not listed.
- Hair and scalp / 3C-4A-4B hair products: PubMed x3, ClinicalTrials.gov (alopecia), WebSearch (curl and bond products). Entries: CCCA registry, curl shampoo. Hair-loss registry hits that were pharmaceutical (alopecia areata JAK programmes) were not listed.
- Goals-aligned science: PDRN, retinal plus azelaic acid, toner study.
- Entropy wildcard: hair as a cortisol record (entry 7), plus cool-water cleansing as a zero-cost behaviour change.
- Rx / OTC / clinical: CCCA registry, retinal plus azelaic acid, hydroquinone-combination safety study. Not listed: a trade-press supplier claim (Debut's DermCeutical PNar, Premium Beauty News, 19 Sep 2026: 0.45% use level, claimed 97% improved over 12 weeks, no sample size or design given; labelled supplier marketing).

## Watch re-check (prior Watch items)
- Mevalonolactone: PubMed re-searched on 25 Oct 2026. No new skin trial or paper found. No change found.
- Thiamidol: PubMed re-searched. The multi-country real-world regimen study is already in the earlier entry. A Delphi consensus on melasma treatment in vitiligo surfaced (Pigment Cell Melanoma Res, 2026) but is not efficacy data. No change found.
- Scalp seborrheic dermatitis and androgenetic alopecia framework: PubMed re-searched. Only the already-cited review surfaced. No change found.

## Build facts
Tailwind compiled via npx (tailwindcss 3.4.17; no cached-CSS fallback message was printed). RDKit was not installed and was not needed: no ingredient structure drawing was made this run. Build output: 13 entries total (10 new), site/index.html about 300 KB.

safetyWatch.text: Renpure scalp shampoo and conditioner recalled on 5 Jun 2026 for contamination with Burkholderia cepacia complex.
Maison Luce lash and brow serum recalled on 18 Feb 2026 because methyl eugenol exceeded the Cosmetic Ingredient Hotlist limit.
Final opinions on the fragrance ingredients acetophenone and heliotropin were published on 15 Oct 2026. Mandates on cuminaldehyde and p-cymene were still pending as of 30 Jul 2026.
TGA continues to flag counterfeit botulinum toxin vials entering the country (page undated).

safetyNote: Reached: Health Canada recall pages, FDA recall landing page (no cosmetics listed to 30 Oct), TGA, EU SCCS and EU health committee pages. Not reached: Korea MFDS, Japan beyond PMDA landing, health-products.canada.ca (client error). This is not a clean bill of health.
